subject: E-5366: crash on launch on macOS
body:
Hi, I'm using CourierOS 3.5.6 on macOS 15.3. Since last week, every time I open
the app, I get 'E-5366: application crashed on launch'.

Since this morning's automatic update the app crashes on start. Everything else
on the machine is as it was.

I've already tried rebooting the router, which changed nothing.

Hannah Cole -- Tessa Labs. Appreciate any pointers.
